The '''holgnot''' was a long, serpent-like creature seen on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Orange and green in color, with a long snout and bulging eyes, the creature could quickly pop out from holes in trees and the ground to attack an enemy.

==Behind the scenes==
The creature was first seen in 1991's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1991 video game)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' video game]], and named in the game's manual.
